title: Quantum super Schur--Weyl duality and character formulas for mirabolic Hecke algebras
summary: We establish a quantum super Schur--Weyl duality for the mirabolic Hecke algebra \(H_n^{\mathrm{mir}}(q)\) with \(q\) indeterminate and determine the corresponding bimodule decomposition. The centralizer of the mirabolic action is shown as a direct sum of homogeneous quantum Schur superalgebras. We describe the tensor-space annihilator and the resulting faithful quotient. When nonzero, the annihilator is generated by an explicit spectral idempotent attached to the smallest rectangle excluded by the hook condition.
